title: Airy Silky Ukrainian Yogurt Bowl
description: A spicy and light Ukrainian dish featuring yogurt, served in a donabe vessel, perfect for a flexitarian diet. This recipe combines the creaminess of yogurt with the tanginess of brine-wet ingredients.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the yogurt, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the grated carrot and chopped fresh dill to the bowl and stir gently.
Arrange the sliced pickled cucumber in the bottom of a donabe vessel.
Spoon the yogurt mixture over the pickled cucumber.
Drizzle the honey over the top, if using.
Cover the donabe and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the Airy Silky Ukrainian Yogurt Bowl chilled, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
